posts.title: Refactoring @export variables in Godot without losing data
posts.description: In Godot, you can use @export variables to edit their values inside the Godot editor. This is especially useful for resources, which are a great way to store your game data. You can think of them like JSON files, but in a way they're more powerful since they can store any Godot resource in them. I'm starting to use them to save information about dialogues.
